choices: No, wait for a current-term entry above it to be on a majority

explain: Sorting the match indexes (5, 5, 4, 3, 1) and taking the middle gives 4. Raft only commits older-term entries indirectly, once a current-term entry after them is on a majority. A stale reply must never move progress backwards.
